system.description:
You have technological upgrades and implants that give you your powers.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Ch9yq1xSypnHNuog]{Energy Burst}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.dv4681MSpvS0fyxn]{Recharge}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.7N906TT16JtDSdXp]{Techno-Absorb}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.wnLg88vMMkfCOAuo]{Tactical Analysis}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Qp6lSTpeFSLaOij0]{Indiscriminate Fabrication}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.9MXpKZV3Kp66rkCY]{Organi-Hack}
Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
